title: Double bookings
summary: Two patients keep being booked with the same doctor at the same time. You are the Database engineer: make the database refuse it, and clean up the bookings that already collide, without losing a single one.
goal: Double bookings at the Hospital OPD
brief:
It is Thursday, 08:20. The front desk of the Hospital OPD reports that two patients were booked with the same doctor at the same date and time. It has happened several times this week and the morning clinic opens at 09:00: two people turn up for one slot.

You are the Database engineer on call. Karan's seat is yours. The app is finished and its tests are in the repo, and there is a snapshot of the production data in fixtures/prod_snapshot.sql. Find out why the database lets it happen, and ship a migration that (a) cleans up the double bookings that already exist without deleting any appointment, and (b) makes sure it cannot happen again. Submit your work: Q runs every test, the Reviewer reads your change, and the Integrator merges it.

The team is in #incident-duplicates. Ananya (QA) has the report with the real rows, Aarav (lead) wants updates, Rohan owns backend/ (read-only for you) and helps if you ask. Every question you ask is counted.

task.title: Fix: stop double bookings in the database

qa.persona: Ananya, QA engineer. Precise, a little tired, reports what she saw with the real rows and never guesses at the cause. She cannot edit database code.
facts: She found three slots that hold two Booked appointments each: {dup_1}; {dup_2}; {dup_3}.
The booking request does not fail: the second patient gets 201 and a confirmation, exactly like the first.
The front desk's slot picker greys out a booked time, but two receptionists booking at the same moment, or a booking made from the phone list, still get through.
Cancelled and Completed appointments can share a slot with a Booked one: that is normal and must keep working.

The tests in tests/db/test_double_bookings.py and tests/api/test_double_booking_api.py show it; run the tests in your folder to see them. The snapshot of the production data is in fixtures/prod_snapshot.sql.

backend.persona: Rohan, backend engineer. Helpful, direct, answers only about backend/ and how the API behaves. He will not add a check to the booking route: he says the database has to refuse it.
facts: The booking route (POST /api/doctors/{id}/appointments) just inserts the row. It does not look for a taken slot, and Rohan does not want a check-then-insert there: two requests at once would still get through.

backend/main.py turns any database refusal (sqlite3.IntegrityError) into a 409 by itself, so if the database refused the second row the route would answer 409 'Slot already booked' without a line of backend code.
He did not change anything in backend/ this week.

fallbacks.text: The route only inserts the row; I will not add a check there, two requests at once would pass it. main.py already turns a database refusal into a 409 by itself, so the rule belongs in the database.

guide.title: Reproduce it
guide.text: Press Run tests and read which tests fail and the first error line of each. That is your starting point. Post a first update in #incident-duplicates within 2 minutes, and answer Aarav within a minute when he asks.

guide.title: Look at the data
guide.text: Ananya quotes real rows. Open fixtures/prod_snapshot.sql (read-only for you) and find the appointments that share a doctor, a date and a time. You can also search the project.

guide.title: Find what the database is missing
guide.text: The booking succeeded, so no rule stopped it. Open the migration that created the index on appointments (database/migrations/0006) and ask yourself what it enforces.

guide.title: Tell the team
guide.text: Post what you found in #incident-duplicates (Agent Chat tab). Aarav is waiting for an update; you can also ask Rohan or Ananya.

guide.title: Add a regression test
guide.text: Add a regression test in tests/regression/ that fails before your fix: book the same slot twice and expect the second to be refused. Name the file test_regression_<what>.py and copy the style of tests/api/test_double_booking_api.py. Run it: it has to be red now and green once the database refuses the second booking.

guide.title: Write the migration
guide.text: Add database/migrations/0008_one_booking_per_slot.sql: first deal with the rows that already collide (no row may be deleted), then make the database refuse a second Booked row for a slot. The index has to work on today's data.

guide.title: Run the tests again
guide.text: Run tests. The whole suite has to be green, not only the acceptance tests.

guide.title: Submit for review
guide.text: Press Submit for review. The Reviewer reads your change and may send it back up to twice.
